source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of Imperial Roman-Byzantine Izani silk lampas brocade in horizontal clavus and tablion bands: warm cream silk ground (#ede3ce) framed by oxidised verdigris (#3b7a6c) Greek-key guard stripes flanking two bold Imperial Sun-Orange (#e07a2a) registers woven in raised metallic gold thread (#d4a838) with 16-rayed Sun medallions alternating with turquoise Palace-Orb roundels (#28a4a8) inside crimson (#9e2a2b) laurel wreaths; exactly four medallions across and two complete register bands down, with plain cream silk margins at top, bottom, left and right seams so no medallion is clipped. Full colour.
